issues.detail: The on_screen text 'INVEST INSTEAD OF SPENDING' is an imperative instruction rather than a neutral heading. The criterion requires explaining the next-best use of money and presenting spending, saving, and investing as context-dependent possibilities without issuing orders to invest.

The narration qualifies enjoyment with guilt ('ask if this optional spending is worth...') rather than teaching the viewer that enjoyment can justify spending. It treats the hypothetical example as a certain lost return instead of an uncertain tradeoff, failing to present either consumption or investing as automatically right or wrong.

The narration states 'by choosing to invest instead' and implies investment returns are certain ('growing that money over time'), whereas the criterion requires acknowledging uncertainty in investment returns. It also narrows the decision rule exclusively to purchases/checkout rather than general money allocation.

The visual_intent description implies a host pose ('Alex standing between') which is unsupported by available assets. The criterion explicitly forbids invented host poses, internal movement, or lettering baked into the image.

The text 'Follow Wealth Blueprint and build wealth on purpose before you buy' narrows the CTA to a checkout context. The criterion requires preserving following the channel as the CTA without narrowing it to checkout or adding new investment instructions.
